caption: The drawing depicts a single jug positioned centrally on a light beige background. The jug is predominantly colored in shades of brown, yellow, green, and hints of blue, giving it a marbled and textured appearance. The jug has a wide, slightly flared mouth, and its body features sculpted forms resembling elongated animals, possibly dogs or hounds, vertically arranged around the sides. The handle is sculpted in the shape of an animal, possibly a canine, with the animal's head forming the top of the handle and its body curving down. The spout is sculpted to resemble a bird with a downward beak and visible feathers. The base of the jug is fluted with a scalloped edge. There are no other objects or details in the background.
title: Pitcher
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
